descFull: The first PC port of The Order: 1886, and the one behind most of the bug fixes so far, now widely used by other projects. It runs natively on Windows 10/11: the PS4’s original cinematic camera, NVIDIA DLSS, up to 4K at 120 FPS, 21:9 ultrawide, 23 languages and its own launcher.
